digest.component_or_area: Claude Code tool-search / MCP tool loading configuration
propositions: Serena's symbol tool schemas are deferred, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip that makes cheaper tools like grep win over the intended navigation tools.
Ship a repo-committed .claude/settings.json setting env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH so MCP tool schemas including Serena's are not deferred, plus a .gitignore negation tracking only that file.
Deferral control is all-or-nothing via ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH; there is no per-server or per-tool lever, so limiting the always-loaded set to <=4 named Serena tools is not implementable.
The measured input-token cost of disabling deferral was recorded: +25,454 tokens serena-only and +63,852 tokens with four MCP servers, justifying the chosen value 'false'.
The dominant token cost is the operator's MCP surface rather than Serena, so trimming connected servers is documented as the operator's lever.
The change is configuration only with a one-line revert documented in docs, guarded by tests asserting valid JSON, a documented value, and correct git tracking of only .claude/settings.json.
